Docket 1.3.150

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $59, or $29.50 at the Black Friday price until 30 November, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *A demo is not placeholder text.* A page offering "a sample private podcast" to try was reported at high severity
  as unfinished template copy. "This is a sample" now counts only when it is a template's own filler, such as "a
  sample page" or "a sample blog post".
- *A product in a review article needs no image.* Products rated in a "best tools" article were reported as
  incomplete markup for lacking an image. Google's product snippet does not need one; only listings for products
  the page sells do.
- *One topic word across most pages is a consistent message.* A site whose main subject appears in two thirds of its
  page descriptions was told it had no consistent message.
- *An empty value is called empty.* Markup that writes a property with nothing in it is now described that way,
  rather than as missing, so the report matches what you see in the code.
- *An area Docket could not read says so in every format.* Areas with no readable page say "no page could be read",
  and the PDF's area table says "not assessed" rather than "not applicable".

99 checks across 13 areas.
